lines: A group world class now waits for its session on World loading, then starts with everyone.
The card names the group, counts down to the start each second, and keeps the action off until then.
At the session's start the class ride opens for everyone, on the panorama if the world isn't ready.
The world keeps loading behind the ride and fades in when it is ready; the clock and the bike carry on.
With no bike at the start, the class still starts, with the lost-bike alert and the group's own words.
The countdown, from a phone to the full screen.
What the tests prove: the countdown, the start with everyone, the late fade, and the missing bike.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
